newsitem.title: CHINA: China Cai Hong sees 420 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: China Cai Hong sees 420 mln share offer.

text.p: Colour television tube maker Cai Hong Display Devices Co Ltd planned to offer about 420 million of its shares abroad to raise funds to expand production, a company official said on Thursday.
The official said the company hoped to make the offer in Hong Kong though Tokyo was also a possibility. The timing, pricing and other details concerning the issue had not yet been fixed.
The company, based in Xianyang in Shaanxi province, is among the 38 domestic firms approved by regulatory authorities last month to list shares on foreign stock markets.
Its A shares for domestic investors are traded on the Shanghai stock exchange.
The company hopes to launch production of 29-inch colour television tubes to meet rising domestic demand, the official said.
He said the company is expected to post a relatively big increase in net profits in 1996, but declined to give further details.
